note: Single source of truth for the Roche page. Only entries verified against the practice's own pages or an institutional record are marked high. Confidence: high | medium | low.

practice.entry: R&Sie founded in Paris by François Roche with Stéphanie Lavaux (partner to 2011) and Gilles Desevedavy (to 1998). Wikipedia gives 1994, after the 'Action' show at the IFA.
Olivier Legrand and Alexandre Boulin, partners.
Name variants R&Sie.D/B:L (1999–2001) and R&Sie… (2001–04); R&Sie(n) from 2004.
Jean Navarro, partner; credited on all projects of the period.
[eIf/bʌt/c], the Institute for Contingent Scenarios, founded with Camille Lacadée; partnership to 2015. M4 / MindMachineMakingMyths is its film department; Lab M4 from 2012.
mythomaniaS; shown at the Chicago Architecture Biennial, 2015.
Retrospective, s/he would rather do FICTION MAKER, FRAC Centre-Val de Loire, Orléans.

projects.title: Hybrid Muscle
projects.place: The Land, Chiang Mai, with Philippe Parreno
projects.entry: Off-grid workroom; an elephant raises concrete counterweights whose descent drives a dynamo; a façade of plastic leaves with pneumatic muscles. Built. Shown at MAM Paris, June–Sept 2002.

projects.title: Dustyrelief / B_mu
projects.entry: Museum for Petch Osathanugrah, ~5,000 m²; an electrostatic aluminium envelope that collects the city's airborne particles into a grey relief, with a white-cube labyrinth inside.

projects.title: Mosquito Bottleneck
projects.entry: House for collectors Ema and Cesar Reyes, ~130 m², 200,000 USD stated; a Klein-bottle loop keeps mosquitoes and humans in interlocking but separate circuits. Completion not confirmed.

projects.title: I've heard about…
projects.place: MAM/ARC, Musée d'Art moderne de la Ville de Paris, at the Couvent des Cordeliers, 7 July – 9 October; Kanazawa 2004–05; De Singel, Antwerp, 2006
projects.entry: A city that grows by local accretion under uncertainty, scripted from inhabitants' speech and chemical signals, built in real time by a machine, the Viab, that secretes fibre-reinforced concrete by a contour-crafting process. R&Sie(n): Roche, Lavaux, Navarro, with Benoît Durandin; machines by Stephan Henrich; contour crafting after Behrokh Khoshnevis (USC).

projects.title: Olzweg
projects.entry: A courtyard filled with recycled glass rods placed by a dispersal script; a robot in random mode stacks and re-stacks the labyrinth over more than ten years. Joint laureate; the commission went to Jakob+MacFarlane; an appeal was filed and withdrawn.

projects.title: Terra Incognita
projects.place: with Pierre Huyghe, in Celebration Park, MAM Paris and Tate Modern
projects.entry: A honeycomb-aluminium island deformed by evaporating water counterweights. A component of Huyghe's work; the film A Journey That Wasn't is Huyghe's.

projects.title: He shot me down
projects.entry: Multipurpose house near the DMZ, ~2,000 m²; shooting trajectories become walkways and light; a machine on a track smears biomass over the exterior as insulation. Robotic design Stephan Henrich.

projects.title: Spidernethewood
projects.entry: House for Urbain and Elisabeth Souriau; polypropylene mesh wrapped around planted trees so vegetation grows into a labyrinth over about five years.

projects.title: Une architecture des humeurs
projects.place: Le Laboratoire, Paris, 4 rue du Bouloi, from 22 January 2010; the press text closes it on 26 April, the CCA record says May
projects.entry: Visitors' body chemistry is read and interpreted as humours; the readings set deliberately uncertain protocols; recursive structural optimisation (François Jouve) generates the morphologies; components secreted by Viab02, a secretion-and-weaving machine extruding bio-cement. Computation Marc Fornes with Winston Hampel and Natanael Elfassy; robotics Stephan Henrich; physiological interview Candice Poitrey. The press text names repulsion, stress and pleasure as the situations from which housing units were conceived, and Jouve as working out dynamic structural strategies; the CCA record names sympathy and empathy, and describes Viab02's bio-cement as a mix of cement and bio-resin.

not_claimed: That Roche engineered robots. The Viab, Viab02 and the Olzweg robot are scenario apparatuses, prototypes, renders and films; robotic design is Stephan Henrich's and contour crafting is Behrokh Khoshnevis's.
That any repository on this site implements Roche's ideas. viab implements stigmergic deposition after TERMES; the Roche link is the name and the precedent of building as an open procedure.
That Olzweg won the FRAC competition. It was a joint laureate; the commission went to Jakob+MacFarlane.
That Dustyrelief, He shot me down or Olzweg were built. Built works verified here: Hybrid Muscle (2002) and Spidernethewood (2007).
That Roche cites Walter, Ashby, Pask or Beer. No such citation was found; the connection to cybernetics is mine.
That 'sweat' is Roche's term. The humours data path is body chemistry read by microneedles.
That T(e)en Years After is a 2002 monograph with an external publisher. It is a short, self-issued French text of 2003–04.
That I've heard about was shown in the MAM building. It was at the museum's temporary venue, the Couvent des Cordeliers.
That Terra Incognita is an R&Sie(n) project. It is a component of Pierre Huyghe's Celebration Park.
That the (n)certainties studio output is Roche's own work. It is student work directed by him.
